name: viewers
title: Viewers
description: The standard viewer top bar (title, status, viewer controls, Refresh, Share, Copy, Download, Open in new tab, Close, overflow menu) with Tailwind panes over it: the Markdown editor with a formatting toolbar and prose styling, the passive HTML preview and source editor, an image viewer with zoom and pan, and a PDF viewer. Owned, editable source over the borrowed controllers; no AI SDK.

.boring-viewer .boring-markdown-source,.font: 0.8125rem/1.65 ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

.boring-viewer .boring-viewer-checker.background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, #d4d4d8 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, #d4d4d8 75%), linear-gradient(45deg, #d4d4d8 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 75%, #d4d4d8 75%)
